title: gradient.rs: Panic when table created with max_entries=0
description: Line 237: When GradientTable::new(0) is called and then update() is invoked, the condition `self.entries.len() >= self.max_entries` evaluates to `0 >= 0` (true), causing `self.entries.remove(0)` to panic on the empty vector. Fix by either asserting max_entries > 0 in new(), or guarding the remove with a len > 0 check.
close_reason: Duplicate of project-LICHEN-worker6-gn1f. Existing guarded update returns false before zero-capacity eviction and focused coverage already exercises new(0), repeated insert/update, direct/IID queries, remove/remove_via, expiry, iteration, and zero allocation. Full lichen-node tests, rustfmt, Clippy -D warnings, and no-default-features check pass; no additional change required.
